defs.def: to come out of your mother's body at the beginning of your life 出生；出世

ex.s: The first rhino to be born at Port Lympne arrived on January 5 to first-time mother Kisima and weighed about 32kg.
ex.t: 在Port Lympne出生第一只犀牛于1月5日来到初次做母亲的Kisima，重约32公斤。

ex.s: His mother, grandmother and great grandmother were all born at the reserve and still live there.
ex.t: 它的母亲、祖母和曾祖母都出生在保护区并且仍然生活在那里。

ex.s: One of the most stressful days of Susan McFrederick's life was watching her son get wheeled away for surgery hours after he was born in 2011.
ex.t: Susan McFrederick一生中最有压力的日子之一就是看着她的儿子在2011年出生几小时后被推去做手术。

ex.s: Answer his/her questions using the following information: You were born in a city with a long history of dragon boat races.
ex.t: 用以下信息回答他/她的问题：你出生在一座有悠久龙舟赛历史的城市。

ex.s: Once marooned out on their islands, locals needed a currency to use among themselves, and so the shell currency was born.
ex.t: 一旦被困在自己的岛上，当地人就需要一种在他们之间使用的货币，于是贝壳货币诞生了。

ex.s: She was born and raised on a large family farm, so the _____45_____ of an agriculture tourism business came naturally to her and began to _____46_____ .
ex.t: 她在一个大家庭农场出生长大，所以创办农业旅游业务的_____45_____对她来说水到渠成，并开始_____46_____。

ex.s: Where was Jena born?
ex.t: 耶拿出生在哪里？

ex.s: Born just before WWII, my grandmother ____23____ an entirely different childhood lifestyle from mine.
ex.t: 我的祖母出生在二战前夕，___23____与我完全不同的童年生活方式。

ex.s: My grandmother was born in Ireland.
ex.t: 我的祖母出生在爱尔兰。

ex.s: He was born in New York City.
ex.t: 他出生在纽约市。

ex.s: When the tiny creature arrived on January 31, she became the 40th black rhino to be born at the reserve.
ex.t: 当这个小家伙1月31日到来时，它成为了保护区出生的第40头黑犀牛。

ex.s: The adorable female calf is the second black rhino born this year at the reserve, but it is too early to tell if the calves will make good candidates to be returned to protected areas of the wild.
ex.t: 这只可爱的雌性幼崽是今年该保护区出生的第二头黑犀牛，但现在判断这些幼崽是否适合被放归野外保护区还为时过早。

ex.s: Three of the four Lincoln sons were born here.
ex.t: 四个林肯儿子中有三个出生在这里。

ex.s: A child born in the US today has   63   very realistic chance of living beyond 100 and needs to plan accordingly.
ex.t: 今天在美国出生的孩子有___63___非常现实的机会活过100岁，因此需要相应地规划。

ex.s: In 1812, the year Charles Dickens was born, there were 66 novels published in Britain.
ex.t: 1812年，查尔斯·狄更斯出生的那一年，英国出版了66部小说。

ex.s: Since 1992 the number of people dying has been bigger than that of those being born by a massive 50%.
ex.t: 自1992年以来，死亡人数比出生人数多出惊人的50%。

ex.s: And，as more children were born，more food ___59___(need).
ex.t: 而且，随着更多孩子的出生，更多的食物___59___（被需要）。

ex.s: The baby was born and update texts were    47    quickly from the overjoyed grandmother, Teresa.
ex.t: 婴儿出生了，欣喜的祖母特蕾莎___47___迅速地发来了报喜短信。

defs.def: to start to exist 思想、机构、感情等

ex.s: The-years went by, and my first grandchild Gordon was born.
ex.t: 我和那一年的班级分享了我的喜悦。

ex.s: Winners are made，not born．
ex.t: 成功者是后天造就的，不是天生的。

defs.def: born in the order, way, place, etc. mentioned 构成复合词

ex.s: Alistair Brownlee, born in 1988, is a British triathlon athlete.
ex.t: 阿利斯泰尔·布朗利，1988年生，是英国铁人三项运动员。

ex.s: Jonny Brownlee, born in 1990, is also a triathlon athlete.
ex.t: 乔尼·布朗利，1990年生，也是一名铁人三项运动员。

ex.s: Mark Twain was born in 1835 in Missouri.
ex.t: 马克·吐温1835年生于密苏里州。

ex.s: I was born with asthma and I never thought I’d be a runner!
ex.t: 我生来就患有哮喘，从没想过自己会成为跑步者！

ex.s: Not every child is born with the willpower of a marathon runner.
ex.t: 并非每个孩子都生来就有马拉松选手那样的意志力。

ex.s: I was born and raised in Cleveland, Ohio in the United States.
ex.t: 由于配对过程涉及许多因素，并非所有报名的学生都能匹配到搭档并能够注册参与本项目。

ex.s: Some people are born physically weaker than others.
ex.t: 如果你有不支持的人，你的话可能不会有太大作用，而且往往让你感到更加沮丧。

ex.s: Spot and Stripe are the first tiger cubs that have ever been born here.
ex.t: 全球范围内，动物园里有三分之一的苏门答腊虎幼崽活不到成年，所以我决定在家里全天候照顾它们。

ex.s: They had their first born in January.
ex.t: 她们在1月有了第一个孩子。

ex.s: Some individuals are born with a gift for public speaking.
ex.t: 有些人天生就具备公开演讲的天赋。

ex.s: I was born legally blind.
ex.t: （翻译待校对补充）

ex.s: “I was born in the country of Wisconsin.
ex.t: "小并不意味着弱，先生，"她为自己辩护道。

ex.s: We are born with them and need only recapture them.
ex.t: 幸运的是，好奇心和不满不需要学习。

ex.s: Then there’s the kind of popularity that appears in adolescence: status born of power and even dishonorable behavior.
ex.t: 还有一种是在青春期出现的那种受欢迎：源于权力甚至不光彩行为的地位。

ex.s: Modern America was born on the road, behind a wheel.
ex.t: 现代美国诞生于公路上、方向盘后。

ex.s: The road novel, the road movie, these are the most typical American ideas, born of abundant petrol, cheap cars and a never-ending interstate highway system, the largest public works project in history.
ex.t: 公路小说、公路电影，这些是最典型的美国观念，诞生于充足的汽油、便宜的汽车和永无止境的洲际高速公路系统——史上最大的公共工程。

ex.s: No one is born a winner． People make themselves into winners by their own （1）     ．
ex.t: 没有人生来就是赢家。人靠自己的（1）___成为赢家。

ex.s: The concept was born when German city planners sought to plant large areas of parkland after World War II in a reproducible way that would need minimal maintenance.
ex.t: 这一理念诞生于二战后德国城市规划者寻求以可复制、低维护的方式种植大片绿地之时。
